title: Reaction Action
prompt: What did the speaker do after hearing they passed the exam?
hint: Name one physical reaction the speaker could not stop doing.

ja.prompt: 試験に合格したと聞いた後、話者は何をしましたか？
ja.hint: 話者が止められなかった身体的な反応を一つ答えてください。

title: Concrete News
prompt: What news did the speaker receive?
